method: Empirical-Bayes beta-binomial shrinkage of per-variant R proportion toward mechanism-class mean (method-of-moments Beta prior). Wilson 95% CI on raw proportion.
interpretation: 1042 variants shrunk; mean |shrunk-raw| 0.1432; 48 variants flip a 0.5 grade. Rare variants pulled toward class mean; standard estimator choice, not an invention.
caveats: Descriptive estimator output for evidence cards; ablate, don't headline. No accuracy claim. Class priors estimated from the same data (empirical Bayes).
supports: M3 shrinkage rung (beta-binomial mechanism-class evidence grading).
